glosses: profile (the shape, view, or shadow of a person's head from the side)
profile (summary or collection of information, especially about a person)
profile (specific space or field in which users can provide various types of personal information in software or Internet systems)

examples.text: Eu mudei minha foto de perfil.
Você mudou sua foto de perfil recentemente?
examples.en: Have you changed your profile picture recently?

examples.text: Eu mudei a foto do perfil.
Eu acho que você deveria mudar sua foto de perfil.
examples.en: I think you should change your profile picture.
